parameters.query:
-- Everything the page shows, in one statement, so every panel is the same snapshot.
WITH cfg AS (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS c FROM config),
creator_views AS (
  SELECT cr.id, count(p.id)::int AS posts, COALESCE(sum(p.views), 0)::bigint AS views
  FROM creators cr LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.creator_id = cr.id
  GROUP BY cr.id
),
star AS (SELECT id FROM creator_views ORDER BY views DESC, id LIMIT 1)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'generated_at', now(),
  'editor_base_url', (SELECT c->>'editor_base_url' FROM cfg),
  'action_token', (SELECT c->>'dashboard_action_token' FROM cfg),
  'rules', (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'min_followers', (c->>'min_followers')::int,
      'review_followers', (c->>'review_followers')::int,
      'rate_cents_per_1k', (c->>'rate_cents_per_1k')::int,
      'min_payout_cents', (c->>'min_payout_cents')::int,
      'payout_ceiling_cents', (c->>'payout_ceiling_cents')::bigint,
      'payout_sanity_multiplier', (c->>'payout_sanity_multiplier')::numeric) FROM cfg),

  'funnel', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(status, n), '{}'::jsonb)
             FROM (SELECT status, count(*)::int AS n FROM submissions GROUP BY status) s),
  'last_submission_at', (SELECT max(created_at) FROM submissions),
  -- The four most recent real applicants of each outcome.
  'examples', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(status, rows), '{}'::jsonb) FROM (
      SELECT status, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'handle', handle, 'platform', platform, 'followers', followers)
             ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rows
      FROM (SELECT s.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn
            FROM submissions s) x
      WHERE rn <= 4
      GROUP BY status) e),
  'invalid_total', (SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(payload->>'external_id', md5(payload::text)))::int
                    FROM dead_letters WHERE reason = 'invalid'),
  'invalid_examples', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(i), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
      SELECT payload->>'handle' AS handle, left(error, 140) AS error
      FROM dead_letters WHERE reason = 'invalid'
      ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 4) i),

  -- One real creator, end to end: the one with the most views.
  'journey', (SELECT to_jsonb(j) FROM (
      SELECT cr.handle, cr.platform, cr.tracking_code, cr.rate_cents_per_1k, cr.onboarded_at,
             s.followers, s.created_at AS applied_at, cv.posts AS post_count,
             (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
                 SELECT url, published_at, views FROM posts
                 WHERE creator_id = cr.id ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 3) p) AS posts,
             (SELECT to_jsonb(py) FROM (
                 SELECT period_start, period_end, post_count, total_views, amount_cents
                 FROM payouts WHERE creator_id = cr.id
                 ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 1) py) AS payout
      FROM star
      JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = star.id
      JOIN submissions s ON s.id = cr.submission_id
      JOIN creator_views cv ON cv.id = cr.id) j),

  'creators', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(c ORDER BY c.views DESC), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
      SELECT cr.handle, cr.platform, cr.tracking_code, cv.posts, cv.views,
             COALESCE((SELECT py.amount_cents FROM payouts py WHERE py.creator_id = cr.id
                       ORDER BY py.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), 0)::bigint AS owed_cents
      FROM creators cr JOIN creator_views cv ON cv.id = cr.id) c),
  'posts_total', (SELECT count(*)::int FROM posts),
  'views_total', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(views), 0)::bigint FROM posts),

  'periods', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(pp ORDER BY pp.period_end DESC), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
      SELECT period_start, period_end, count(*)::int AS creators, sum(amount_cents)::bigint AS total_cents
      FROM payouts GROUP BY period_start, period_end
      ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 6) pp),

  'dead_letters_open', (SELECT count(*)::int FROM dead_letters WHERE replayed_at IS NULL),
  'dead_letters', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
      SELECT id, workflow_name, node, kind, reason, left(error, 240) AS error,
             payload->>'handle' AS handle, created_at, execution_url
      FROM dead_letters WHERE replayed_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) d)
) AS state;

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) AS config
FROM config;
